notes: G1-G5 and Profile are not forwarded to the pad unless a mapping routes them, so the pad must stay quiet; Start arrives as the Guide button (report 0x02). Use it after touching key mappings.

steps.detail: G1 is on the front. Press it, let go, press it again, let go. The pad should send nothing for this key unless a mapping routes it.
steps.title: Press G1 twice

steps.detail: G2 is on the front. Press it, let go, press it again, let go. The pad should send nothing for this key unless a mapping routes it.
steps.title: Press G2 twice

steps.detail: G3 is on the front. Press it, let go, press it again, let go. The pad should send nothing for this key unless a mapping routes it.
steps.title: Press G3 twice

steps.detail: G4 is on the front. Press it, let go, press it again, let go. The pad should send nothing for this key unless a mapping routes it.
steps.title: Press G4 twice

steps.detail: G5 is on the front. Press it, let go, press it again, let go. The pad should send nothing for this key unless a mapping routes it.
steps.title: Press G5 twice

steps.detail: Profile is on the front. Press it, let go, press it again, let go. The pad should send nothing for this key. Each press also switches the controller's own profile. Paddles and SAX keys left on Controller's profile change with it; remapped ones keep sending only your pick.
steps.title: Press Profile twice

steps.detail: Start is on the front. Press it, let go, press it again, let go. The pad shows Start as the Guide button.
steps.title: Press Start twice

title: G keys, Profile and Start
